description: This file contains utility functions for detecting and interfacing with the Triton package and related hardware capabilities, including version checks, device support, and backend configuration.

methods.name: has_triton_package
methods.description: Checks if the Triton package is installed.

methods.name: get_triton_version
methods.description: Retrieves the Triton package version as a tuple of major and minor numbers.

methods.name: _device_supports_tma
methods.description: Checks if the device supports Triton Memory Access (TMA) based on CUDA capability.

methods.name: has_triton_experimental_host_tma
methods.description: Determines if Triton experimental host TMA is available.

methods.name: has_triton_tensor_descriptor_host_tma
methods.description: Checks for the presence of Triton tensor descriptor host TMA.

methods.name: has_triton_tma
methods.description: Checks if either experimental or tensor descriptor host TMA is available.

methods.name: has_triton_tma_device
methods.description: Checks if the device supports Triton TMA, considering CUDA and XPU capabilities.

methods.name: has_datacenter_blackwell_tma_device
methods.description: Checks for specific device capabilities related to datacenter Blackwell TMA devices.

methods.name: has_triton_stable_tma_api
methods.description: Checks for the availability of a stable Triton TMA API.

methods.name: has_triton
methods.description: Determines if Triton is available and compatible with the current device and configuration.

methods.name: triton_backend
methods.description: Retrieves the Triton backend object based on the current driver target.

methods.name: triton_hash_with_backend
methods.description: Generates a hash string representing the Triton backend configuration.
